exact_statement: Knocking down GENE-X with CRISPRi reduces the INFLAMMATORY-SIGNATURE score in primary donor-derived macrophages at 48 hours, and this has been independently replicated.

assay.controls: non-targeting guides, same donors, same batch
assay.batches: two, each containing three donors and both conditions
assay.replicates: six donors, each contributing both conditions

falsification_conditions: the donor-level difference is indistinguishable from label assignment under a within-donor permutation
the effect reverses in any donor with adequate cell recovery
a generic stress signature moves at least as much as the claimed signature
allowed_scope: primary human macrophages from these six donors, CRISPRi at 48 hours, this signature, this preprocessing. Nothing outside those bounds.
